# The Pet's Butler

> Pet sitting, dog walking and house visits in Centurion and Gauteng, South Africa. Founded by Rudi Beukes in 1997.

The Pet's Butler is a family-style pet-care business based in Rooihuiskraal, Centurion, serving clients in Centurion, Pretoria, Johannesburg and surrounding Gauteng communities. New service inquiries are for Gauteng. Existing clients travelling outside Gauteng can use the client access option on the website.

The Pet's Butler is part of Aslana Intelligence (Pty) Ltd, owned by founder Rudi Beukes. The company uses a business WhatsApp account to receive booking enquiries.

## Services
- Day pet sitting
- Day pet sitting is available for puppies and small-breed dogs only; larger adult breeds cannot be accommodated in the available space.
- Dog walking (currently fully booked; call for cancellations or future availability)
- House visits
- Overnight boarding / sleepovers (currently fully booked; call for cancellations or future availability)

The online shop is currently under reconstruction. The future collection is being planned around reward-sized training bites, single-ingredient treats, dental chews, lick mats, puzzle and sniff toys, treat pouches, poo bags, reflective walk gear, car safety tethers and washable blankets. Treats are only provided with the pet owner's permission and instructions.

## Local travel rates
Dog walking and house visits include local travel from Rooihuiskraal: R100 in Rooihuiskraal, The Reeds and Wierda Park; R120 in Amberfield, Thatchfield and Rooihuiskraal North; R125 in Eldoraigne; up to R150 in the extended Centurion area. Choose a suburb in the booking form to see its per-visit rate. Other Centurion suburbs should be confirmed by phone.
